title: Honor workspace deep links on initial load
outcome: Opening TermAl with ?workspace=<saved-id> fetches the requested saved layout successfully, but the UI does not adopt that workspace. Trace the cold-start layout/session hydration ordering and ensure the requested server workspace wins without being overwritten by placeholder/default state.
acceptance: A cold load at a saved workspace query URL renders that workspace after state hydration; the requested layout is not overwritten by initial/default persistence; regression coverage exercises the query-selected server layout; UI typecheck/tests/build pass.
